question.article:
Dear Team,
The annual inventory count will begin at 7 A.M. Saturday. [1] _____ the warehouse is normally closed on weekends, only employees assigned to the count should enter the building. Team leaders will receive printed checklists when they [2] _____. Please record damaged items separately so they can be reviewed later. Each product's assigned shelf must match its location on the checklist. [3] _____
We expect the work to be [4] _____ by noon.
question.stem: Choose the best word for [1].
question.explanation: 仓库周末通常关闭是后续限制进入人员的背景原因。

items.correctBasis: Because the warehouse is normally closed，解释仅指派员工能入场的背景
distractorReasons: Despite 后不能直接接完整从句
Unless 表条件例外不符合已定的入场限制
During 为介词不能接完整从句

question.article:
Dear Team,

Each product's assigned shelf must match its location on the checklist. [3] _____
We expect the work to be [4] _____ by noon.
question.stem: Which sentence best completes blank [3] in the inventory notice?
options: Staff may change shelf location codes whenever they find a better layout.
Team leaders should replace the inventory checklists with sales brochures.
Employees who are not assigned to the count may enter the warehouse to help.
Do not move products between shelves during the count.
question.explanation: 原文要求每件商品的货架位置与清单上的位置一致，因此盘点期间不得随意移动货物。A允许变更货架编码，与固定位置要求冲突；B以销售手册取代盘点清单，违背已安排发放盘点清单的要求；C允许未获指派的人员入仓，违背仅限盘点人员进入的明确限制。D是唯一符合操作要求的完整句子。

items.correctBasis: 文档要求各产品货架与盘点清单一致，因此不能在盘点时跨货架移动产品，应选择完整句D
distractorReasons: A允许任意变动位置编码违背账实一致
B把库存检查单改成销售册违背已发清单
C允许未获指派者入库违背仅限指派人员

question.article:
Dear Team,
The annual inventory count will begin at 7 A.M. Saturday. [1] _____ the warehouse is normally closed on weekends, only employees assigned to the count should enter the building. Team leaders will receive printed checklists when they [2] _____. Please record damaged items separately so they can be reviewed later. Each product's assigned shelf must match its location on the checklist. [3] _____
We expect the work to be [4] _____ by noon.
question.stem: Choose the best word for [4].
question.explanation: We expect the work to be completed by noon 中 to be completed 为被动完成。A completes 是第三人称单数谓语，不能跟在 to be 后；C completing 无法在此构成受事 work 的被动语态；D completion 是名词。旧题的 complete 是合法形容词表语，故在新版删除以避免双答案。

items.correctBasis: work to be completed by noon 表示工作被完成，答案是 B completed
distractorReasons: completes 为单数谓语不能接 to be
completing 不能构成工作作为受事的被动
completion 名词不能在此与 be 构成所需完成结构

question.article:

Work on the first-floor reading room is progressing on schedule. The new lighting has already been installed, and the flooring will be replaced next week. [1] _____ this work is underway, the reading room will remain closed. Visitors may use the second-floor study area [2] _____. The information desk has been moved near the main entrance to make staff easier to [3] _____. We appreciate your patience while these improvements are [4] _____.
question.stem: Choose the best word for [1].
question.explanation: 施工进行期间阅览室关闭，While 表“在……期间”。

items.correctBasis: While this work is underway 后完整从句表示施工期间
distractorReasons: Unless 表除非不适合关闭期间事实
Because of 不能接完整从句
Therefore 是副词不能在此直接引导从句

question.article:
Subject: Revised Training Date
The customer-service seminar originally planned for June 6 has been moved to June 13. The change was necessary because the instructor [1] _____ to attend an industry conference. Employees who registered for June 6 do not need to register again. Their reservations will be transferred [2] _____. If the new date is not convenient, participants may request a cancellation. [3] _____ requests should be submitted by June 9. We apologize for any inconvenience the schedule change may have [4] _____.
question.stem: Choose the best word for [1].
question.explanation: 改期的原因是讲师当时被要求出席行业会议，使用单数主语的被动结构 was required to attend。were required 与单数 instructor 不一致；is requiring 后不应直接接 to attend；have been required 与单数主语不一致。旧版 needed 与 will need 在缺失通知日期时都可能符合上下文，所以新题采用更明确的被动形式。

items.correctBasis: the instructor was required to attend 被动描述被安排出席会议
distractorReasons: were required 与单数 instructor 不一致
is requiring 后不能直接不定式作受事人要求
have been required 与单数主语不一致
